chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the maternal siblings along with the grandfather, and he said: “The prescribed share of the maternal siblings is one-third along with the grandfather.”

key_terms.الْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ الْأُمِّ: maternal siblings, meaning siblings related through the mother
key_terms.الْجَدِّ: the grandfather in the law of inheritance

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal siblings when a grandfather is also present?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance involving maternal siblings and a grandfather. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that the maternal siblings retain their prescribed share of one-third even when the grandfather is present.
